run_dump_hubert_feature_s2t: run the CLI to dump HuBERT features from audio files listed in a TSV using a S2T checkpoint
run_HubertFeatureReaderS2T_read_audio: run the HubertFeatureReaderS2T class to read an audio file and return a 1D waveform tensor
run_get_path_iterator: run get_path_iterator to shard a TSV of audio paths and yield file paths for a given rank
run_main: run main to extract HuBERT features from audio files and dump them to a feature directory
review_HubertFeatureReaderS2T: review the HubertFeatureReaderS2T class that extends HubertFeatureReader with S2T-compatible audio loading
